review.rationale: The release changes leave decoding, same-day leave behavior and React Native UI in JavaScript, plus deployment automation. Native dependencies, lockfile, native modules and permissions are unchanged. Restoring only the verified deployment shortcut and additive temporary-output exclusions reproduces the installed v1.0.1 APK fingerprint exactly.
evidence: Compared all committed master-to-develop changes and the complete production APK baseline at 9edf9d1f989b61aae7db96d54e23fe8be2ba7bf8.
Production APK v1.0.1 uses app version 1.0.1, Android versionCode 2 and channel production; these values remain unchanged.
Native compatibility calculation reproduced runtime 7e3df9398006bc04f4400ac26189dd6c3b36ef9a using the SDK fingerprint API after only the declared administrative normalization.
package.json differs only in update:production; package-lock.json, Expo/React Native/native dependencies, config plugins, native modules and app permissions are unchanged.
Ignore-file additions only exclude known generated deployment records; lifecycle and EAS build hooks are not changed.
app.config.js retains fingerprint policy for native builds and permits the existing APK runtime only in the guarded verified production master OTA child process.
The merge of current origin/master and the reviewed develop source produces the same source tree, so the review remains valid through this merge.
Weekly-free and same-day leave SQL migrations are recorded as already applied in the repository reports; this PR does not apply SQL or issue leave grants.
Uncommitted Discord log-monitor code, configuration and tests are excluded from the release source.
Clean npm ci, lint, typecheck, all 164 committed unit tests and test-variant web export passed in an isolated checkout.
Temporary review output exclusions are root-anchored; the committed .github/deployment-review.json remains trackable and is covered by a regression test.

gates: fresh review and production APK native comparison
latest-master and runtime recheck before EAS publication

limitations: No EAS Update, APK build or physical-device installation was performed during PR preparation.
Web production promotion remains on the separate APK release path.
